title: Neuroprotective effects of dimethyl fumarate against depression-like behaviors via astrocytes and microglia modulation in mice: possible involvement of the HCAR2/Nrf2 signaling pathway.
authors: de Souza, Alana Gomes; Lopes, Iardja Stefane; Filho, Adriano Jose Maia Chaves; Cavalcante, Talita Matias Barbosa; Oliveira, Joao Victor Souza; de Carvalho, Michele Albuquerque Jales; de Lima, Klistenes Alves; Juca, Paloma Marinho; Mendonca, Sabrina Silva; Mottin, Melina; Andrade, Carolina Horta; de Sousa, Francisca Clea Florenco; Macedo, Danielle S; de Franca Fonteles, Marta Maria
one_liner_zh: 该文研究富马酸二甲酯的抗抑郁神经保护机制，涉及小胶质细胞/星形胶质细胞调节及HCAR2/Nrf2通路，仅含少量小分子-蛋白对接计算，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: We postulated that dimethyl fumarate (DMF) exerts neuroprotective effects against depression-like behaviors through astrocytes and microglia modulation. To ascertain our hypothesis and define the mechanistic pathways involved in effect of DMF on neuroinflammation, we used the depression model induced by chronic unpredictable mild stress (CUMS), in which, the mice were exposed to stressful events for 28 days and from the 14th day they received DMF in the doses of 50 and 100 mg/kg or fluoxetine 10 mg/kg or saline. On the 29th day, the animals were subjected to behavioral tests. Microglia (Iba1) and astrocyte (GFAP) marker expressions were evaluated by immunofluorescence analyzes and the cytokines TNF-alpha and IL-Ibeta by immunoenzymatic assay. In addition, computational target prediction, 3D protein structure prediction, and docking calculations were performed with monomethyl fumarate (DMF active metabolite) and the Keap1 and HCAR2 proteins, which suggested that these could be the probable targets related protective effects. CUMS induced anxiety- and depressive-like behaviors, cognitive deficit, decreased GFAP, and increased Iba1, TNF-alpha, and IL-Ibeta expression in the hippocampus. These alterations were reversed by DMF. Thus, it is suggested that one of the mechanisms involved in the antidepressant effect of DMF is neuroinflammatory suppression, through the signaling pathway HCAR2/Nrf2. However, more studies must be performed to better understand the molecular mechanisms of this drug.
abstract_zh: 我们假设富马酸二甲酯（DMF）通过星形胶质细胞和小胶质细胞的调节，对抑郁样行为发挥神经保护作用。为验证我们的假设并明确DMF对神经炎症作用的机制途径，我们采用了慢性不可预知轻度应激（CUMS）诱导的抑郁模型，其中小鼠暴露于应激事件28天，从第14天起接受50和100 mg/kg剂量的DMF、10 mg/kg的氟西汀或生理盐水。第29天，对动物进行行为测试。通过免疫荧光分析评估小胶质细胞（Iba1）和星形胶质细胞（GFAP）标记物的表达，并通过免疫酶法测定细胞因子TNF-α和IL-1β。此外，进行了计算靶点预测、3D蛋白质结构预测和对接计算，涉及单甲基富马酸酯（DMF活性代谢物）与Keap1和HCAR2蛋白，提示这些可能是与保护效应相关的潜在靶点。CUMS诱导了焦虑和抑郁样行为、认知缺陷、海马中GFAP降低以及Iba1、TNF-α和IL-1β表达增加。这些改变被DMF逆转。因此，提示DMF抗抑郁效应涉及的机制之一是神经炎症抑制，通过HCAR2/Nrf2信号通路实现。然而，仍需更多研究以更好地理解该药物的分子机制。
